notes.title: Elemental Contest!
notes.content:
[h2]ELEMENTAL CONNECTION TOURNAMENT![/h2][p][/p][p]With prize(s)! 

Hey everyone, we're going to be doing a tournament in Elemental Connection (nee ECON), the 2-player game of matching tiles.[/p][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/772b1389435f896770e8d46c57e3033786497484.png"][/img][/h3][h3]RULES [/h3][list][*][p]Each contestant competes against every other contestant once only.[/p][/*][*][p]Contestants will do a single 1-v-1 match against each other at a time they choose.[/p][list][*][p]Players can choose to play their game live for everyone to see, or play it in private.[/p][list][*][p]Both players must send a screenshot or video of the final score screen for it to count.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We're using an integrity system here. There's probably a way to cheat this but... don't! Please? [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]SCORING [/h3][list][*][p]You gain points in each match equal to your final points in that round. Even if you lose the match, you gain those points.[/p][/*][*][p]All of your points will be summed together and then multiplied by a Multiplier at the end.[/p][/*][*][p]Your Multiplier starts at 1.0. Every time you win a match, your multiplier increases by 0.1.[/p][list][*][p]For you math people, your scoring equation looks like this: [/p][/*][*][p]T = N * (1.0 + (0.1 * V))[/p][/*][*][p]T = Total points [/p][/*][*][p]N = Sum of all points through all games [/p][/*][*][p]V = Number of victories[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]PRIZE(S)[/h3][p]The winner of the tournament will get a key for the next Twelve Tiles game, Social Caterpillar (Remake) on Steam. [/p][p][/p][p]Depending on the turnout, we might include further prizes for runner-ups. But mostly this is just a bit of fun![/p][p]   [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514940/Social_Caterpillar/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]SIGN UP and MORE DETAILS[/h3][p]
If you'd like to sign up, or want more details, pop in to the [url="https://discord.com/invite/Qu4Xf7w"]Twelve Tiles Discord Server.[/url]

Sign-up ends and the contest starts officially on September 22nd, 2025, the Autumnal Equinox.

[url="https://discord.com/invite/Qu4Xf7w" style="button"]Twelve Tiles Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Social Caterpillar - Wishlist the Next Twelve Tiles Game!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/334e3aacea671a035976b0d2ae0a60f231a39b43.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to formally announce [b]Social Caterpillar[/b], a puzzle adventure set within the framework of introversion and socialization.  Move through different dioramas, leashed only by your Social Energy. Interact with friends, family, and strangers in the form of abstracted conversational puzzles, each with its own discrete logic. The more you engage with Living Humans, the more Social Energy you'll gain to explore the world!  You can WISHLIST it here! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3514940/Social_Caterpillar/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Some of you [url="https://www.twelvetiles.com/socialcaterpillar"]may recognize the game[/url]. This is an update and re-release of the original Social Caterpillar in a new engine. If you played the old version (or would still like to), that's okay! This is a total upgrade. You can expect: [/p][list][*][p] New puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]Double the locations[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of secrets to discover[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life changes[/p][/*][*][p]Updated graphics and music[/p][/*][*][p]A second layer of implicit narrative[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/047139a607a12f569d15e4b38499e009dcc6c6d6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/6a9bdd712fa12156bf83b9aa965eabbf3585ad06.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33934377/30fb0757551d591762a649f1b6002a6fede494a6.png"][/img][/p][p]We can expect the game to release later this year. If you'd like more details, or think you'd be interested in some of the testing, [url="https://discord.com/invite/RDAyjaejDJ"]join us on our Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks, everyone, for the support![/p]

notes.title: Elemental Connection Rebrand Update!
notes.content:
Elemental Connection rebrand!

When I made this game around 2002-ish, I called it Elemental Connection. It stayed that way all up until the digital release, where some friends said it'd work better as ECON. I never really cared for that, so I figured, with this next batch of little fixes I'd just go ahead and do a soft rebranding to Elemental Connection again. Back to the roots, babeh! It won't be official on Steam until I get, like, 50 reviews, but for now I hope you all enjoy the updated name and look.

I also got it working on Mac... I think! Test it and let me know!

- Rebranded to Elemental Connection
- Turned off TOUCH sensor
- Change default player name so it's not 0
- Added 3 boards to multiplayer
- Added 4 more songs
- Changed Master Volume changer into Music and SFX separately
- Changed internal jukebox junk
- Show which song is playing in menu during play
- Added 2 new backgrounds
- Added ability to sample music in options menu
- Changed some icons/GUI
- Tweaked menu timing to prevent some overlap bugs
- Updated spinner image
- Updated victory section
- Added Fullscreen option to mid-game menu
- Modified multiplayer Emotes a bit, and added a sad one
- Added animation shorcut in options menu
- Works on MacOS (I hope, needs more testing)
- Other bug fixes


Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Hotfix 21.10.25
notes.content:
Fixed a couple other things, mostly the stuff I broke with the last fix!

- You can now EXIT the game like a normal person playing a normal game
- "Stray sounds" have been tied to the volume control
- Fixed a little of the menu GUI when playing multiplayer as a Peer
- Sharpened some AI by just a hair, you won't notice

notes.title: Hotfix 21.10.24
notes.content:
Did some work under the hood!

- Online play should no longer be bugged when using Q and E to rotate
- Game remembers screen size settings
- Game remembers audio settings
- Made the volume reduce to "OFF" instead of "2%"


Known issues:

- Little faces disappear in online mode after going to menu
- The EXIT command leaves the window open

notes.title: Achievements Unlocked
notes.content:
[b]ECON [/b]now has functional [b]Achievements [/b]here in Steam!

If you've played [b]ECON [/b]and earned [b]Achievements [/b]that didn't register to Steam, you should be able to simply reload the game to activate those dormant [b]Achievements[/b].

If you find any conflicts with the [b]Achievements [/b]the game says you have earned and what Steam says you have earned, please send an email to [i]merlandese@gmail.com[/i] so that I can help you unlock them.

Thanks for playing!
